name: Do Lixo se Faz Música
description: This workshop teaches participants to create music from discarded objects, promoting environmental awareness through creativity and sound organization. It is designed for families and the general public over 6 years old.
longDescription:
The workshop "Do Lixo se Faz Música" (From Trash, Music is Made) takes place at Casa da Música on Saturday, November 28, 2026. There are two sessions available: one at 10:30 and another at 14:30. The event is held in Sala Ensaio 2.

Led by formador Paulo Coelho de Castro, the workshop focuses on giving new life to discarded objects by transforming them into musical instruments. This activity aims to foster creativity in sound organization and contribute to environmental consciousness.

Tickets are priced at €7.50 per person, with a special price of €22 for four people. The event is part of the Casa Educa program and is suitable for families and individuals aged 6 and above.

longDescriptionPt:

Conduzido pelo formador Paulo Coelho de Castro, o workshop foca-se em dar uma nova vida a objetos descartados, transformando-os em instrumentos musicais. Esta atividade visa fomentar a criatividade na organização sonora e contribuir para a consciência ambiental.

Os bilhetes têm o preço de 7,50€ por pessoa, com um preço especial de 22€ para quatro pessoas. O evento faz parte do programa Casa Educa e é adequado para famílias e indivíduos com 6 anos ou mais.
